title: SDK surface launch: stakeholder syndication & compatibility runbook for function-calling, structured output, streaming
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Objective: Coordinate a cross-team syndication and compatibility runbook to ship the SDK surface enhancements that enable function-calling, structured output types, and streaming. This ticket consolidates release notes, docs updates, sample curation, SDK changelogs, compatibility matrices, and stakeholder signoffs so the launch is predictable and auditable.

Scope: final copy and approval of release notes, docs page updates for SDKs (Python/Node/Go), curated sample repository (examples for tool-calling, JSON schema outputs, streaming handlers), compatibility matrix across model families and runtime flags, telemetry gating definitions, and comms cadence for partners & marketplace.

Out-of-scope: API implementation work, runtime kernel optimizations (tracked under ENG-9401), and design system refactors beyond sample UX flows.

Acceptance criteria:
- Release notes drafted and approved by PM + Legal + Security.
- Docs pages updated with code samples for Python, Node, Go and verified against SDK test harness.
- Samples repo contains 6 validated examples (2 tool-calling, 2 structured-output, 2 streaming) with CI passing.
- Compatibility matrix confirmed with Runtime & Infra engineers for default kernel options and quantization knobs.
- Telemetry gating and rollback thresholds defined and instrumented in console dashboards.
- Cross-functional launch checklist completed and 2-week post-launch follow-up scheduled.
checklist: Draft release notes (PM) - include breaking changes, migration steps, examples
Legal review for release notes and sample data (Legal)
Security review for sample code and default keys (Security)
Docs update PRs for SDKs (Docs + SDK Eng) - Python/Node/Go
Curate samples repo and add CI smoke tests (SDK Eng) - 6 canonical examples
Compatibility matrix: map features to model variants and runtime flags (Runtime Eng)
Define telemetry signals & dashboard widgets for rollout (Observability)
Prepare partner comms, marketplace artifacts, and migration guide (GTM)
Run preflight checklist and dry-run rollout in staging (QA + Infra)
deliverables: Docs pages updated (Guides: function-calling, structured-output, streaming)
Samples repo PR with 6 examples and CI green
Compatibility matrix CSV attached to runtime-oncall drive
Telemetry dashboard prep in Console (token-level SLOs & errors)
risk_mitigation: If structured output serialization regressions are detected, default to stable schema v1 and flag users to opt-in to v2
Fallback policy: route streaming requests to non-streaming synchronous endpoint under high error rates
Feature flag gating for early canary customers and internal pilots
Dedicated rollback runbook accessible from the console with playbook link
Post-launch monitoring window with on-call runtime engineers for 72 hours
rollout_phases: Phase 0 - Internal pilot: SDK alpha to internal apps and Redwood demos (1 week)
Phase 1 - Canary: 5 trusted customers and partner apps (2 weeks)
Phase 2 - Gradual rollout: 25% traffic with auto-rollback thresholds (1 week)
Phase 3 - GA: public SDK docs, samples, and marketplace listing
telemetry_and_signals: Median token latency increases > 30% vs baseline triggers auto-throttle
Schema validation failures in structured outputs > 0.5% triggers rollback candidate
Streaming disconnect rate > 2% of sessions triggers canary halt
Adoption metrics: number of unique SDK keys using new APIs per day
